ko.executive_summary: PMIC demand is being reshaped by AI workload displacement toward mature-node capacity. SMIC and Huahong are capturing 8-inch BCD and analog volumes as TSMC/Samsung deprioritize legacy nodes, with SMIC reporting record Q2 revenue, record inquiries, and 3.6x net profit growth. Leadtrend's gross margin rebounded to 33.6% as AI crowds out mature-process capacity, signaling pricing power and utilization tightness in the PMIC supply chain.
key_facts: SMIC Q2 net profit up 3.6x; Q2 China revenue surged 22%
SMIC reports record revenue and record foreign-client inquiries
Leadtrend FY2026 Q1 net profit up 182% QoQ; gross margin 33.6%
TSMC, Samsung shift focus to advanced nodes; SMIC/Huahong seizing 8-inch demand
SMIC flags US equipment supply delays despite record revenue

implications.text: AI workloads crowding out mature-process capacity at foundries; PMIC/analog fabs (SMIC, Huahong) seeing accelerated demand and margin expansion as TSMC/Samsung vacate legacy nodes.
Gross margin rebound to 33.6% at Leadtrend and record profitability at SMIC indicate sustained pricing power for mature-node PMICs amid supply tightness.
SMIC reports US equipment supply delays; geopolitical/sanctions headwinds on fabs serving foreign clients may constrain future capacity ramps and supply continuity.
Foreign OEMs shifting PMIC orders back to China (SMIC) as onshore capacity expands; may reduce geographic diversification in PMIC supply base over 12–18 months.

ko.counterpoint: AI-driven mature-node demand surge may be temporary or capacity-driven; Leadtrend's margin rebound tied to inventory normalization, not structural pricing, and US equipment restrictions could reverse SMIC's record trajectory if wafer-start constraints tighten.
